Complaints? Video submissions? Tips? Sponsorships? Collabs? Business inquires?

Epic's software has been used to manage medical records for approximately 78% of patients in the United States, and over 3% of patients worldwide. The company employs around 13,000 people and reported revenues of $4.6 billion in previous years. When our team reached out to Epic Systems regarding Dvorak's arrest, they responded expressing no further comment on the incident. To wrap this up, why was someone with things to lose in life want to be pulled off a plane and arrested? But that's what he wanted and that's what he got. It cares about your actions.
